name: velista-e2e
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project velista-e2e --web
// e2e: The @nx/playwright plugin infers a dependsOn shell:serve from the webServer.command in playwright.config.ts. That makes Nx start the shell AND Playwright start it again, racing on port 4200. Overriding dependsOn to [] lets Playwright's webServer own the single instance (it waits on `url` and reuses an existing serve). Mirrors apps/landing-v2-e2e/project.json.
